scope: PostgreSQL migrations, memory/runtime repositories, planner and graph checkpoints, and restart boundaries
key_findings: P5-01 planner-session repository/schema has no explicit scope binding
P5-02 memory service operations load/mutate by ID without expected caller scope

P5-05 LangGraph4j checkpoint tenant separation relies on scope/execution-derived thread ID
